50.name: Epic Party
50.overview: 24 returning players are abandoned on the islands of Fiji for a monumental 50th season, with the chance to win $1 million. Castaways reflect on how much they have changed since the last time they played the game. An unforeseen injury during the first immunity challenge causes tribemates to rethink their attack strategy in order to support their team member.

50.name: Therapy Carousel
50.overview: Following an emotional medical evacuation, castaways are forced to go back to the drawing board and reassess their alliances. One castaway's attempt to publicly set the record straight sends shockwaves through the rest of camp. The reward challenge is a smash hit as tribes must shatter all other's hopes of coming in first. Then, differences in work ethic cause strain among tribemates.

50.name: Did You Vote For a Swap?
50.overview: A foreboding treemail message leaves castaways hungry for information regarding an imminent change. Knowledge is power as the boomerang idols begin to rear their heads within tribes. Then, past mistakes and baggage haunt players in their quest for redemption.

50.name: Knife to the Heart
50.overview: Castaways help pass the time on their beach by hosting the Survivor 50 Talent Show. Another boomerang idol is discovered, and players must decide whether to send it to an ally or an adversary. Then, the biggest reward of the season is on the line as tribes compete for immunity and a special afternoon with country music star and survivor superfan, Zac Brown.

50.name: Open Wounds
50.overview: Tensions flare after Tribal Council when one castaway's self-proclaimed "temper tantrum" rubs some members of their tribe the wrong way. Rivals clash in "Operation Bad Blood" and the stakes rise as two tribes are sent to Tribal Council.

50.name: The Blood Moon
50.overview: A mysterious boat arrives delivering an exciting message, "Drop your buffs!" A mad dash ensues when castaways discover that an advantage is hidden deep in the jungle. This week's mouthwatering challenge reward lifts spirits, but only briefly. When the dreaded blood moon is triggered (a true Survivor first), it leads to a historic tribal council.

50.name: That's Not How I Play Survivor
50.overview: Feelings of betrayal hit an all-time high following a historic Blood Moon tribal that featured three eliminations. One person is selected to go on a journey with the potential to earn an advantage. Then, a schoolyard pick at this week's challenge leads one team to reward and one individual to immunity.

50.name: Double the Fun, Double the Demise
50.overview: A boat arrives asking the tribe to divide themselves into pairs. This week’s immunity challenge features one of the biggest twists ever seen in Survivor history. Then, a theatrical risk taken at tribal council must be enough to cast doubt upon those on the chopping block.

50.name: I Deserve All of This
50.overview: After losing two alliance members, castaways spend the next day picking up the pieces of their broken alliance. The castaways face off against a surprise challenger during this week's individual immunity competition. Then, upon their return to camp, the journey participant must read aloud an important announcement regarding their recent adventure.

50.name: A Side Dish of Chaos
50.overview: One castaway comes clean to the tribe about a previously deceptive move. The crowd favorite Survivor auction returns, with an extra special season 50 spin. Also, chaos ensues when social media icon MrBeast arrives on the scene.

50.name: Everyone Will Be Shooketh!
50.overview: Castaways find themselves on both a literal and figurative island after their return from what is regarded as one of the "craziest tribals of all time." Castaways reflect on their letters from home and the family members that have impacted them. Then, a shocking incident takes place at this week's immunity challenge.

50.name: Inconceivable
50.overview: This week's immunity challenge is riddled with frustration, putting slow and steady gameplay to the test. As the race to $2 million draws closer, idols and advantages come to the forefront. Then, a self‑proclaimed "rat" at the Manulevu camp spills information in hopes of leading to personal triumph.

50.name: Reverse the Curse
50.overview: Back from tribal, tensions rise following the exit of a particularly historic player. The final five immunity challenge ends in a showdown and features one of the closest finishes the show has ever seen. Jeff reveals the outcomes of the remaining in-game fan votes and how they impact the final stage of the competition. Then, one castaway will be crowned Sole Survivor and awarded the $2 million prize, during the three-hour live season finale of Survivor 50.

51.name: Permanent Uncertainty
51.overview: Castaways marooned in remote Fiji embark upon the Open Era of Survivor and battle to win $1 million. The catchphrase of the season, "permanent uncertainty," comes into play as soon as the castaways reach the beach and discover that one player must leave to go on a mysterious journey. Then, the first tribal council pits two allies against each other in a dramatic battle of wills.

51.name: Weaponized Honesty
51.overview: A chilling injury at camp threatens to send one player home. Two tribes face off in a daunting immunity challenge at sea where one tribe struggles to keep afloat. Then, tribal council takes a wild turn when one player attempts a never-before-seen move to save an ally.

51.name: What I'm Smellin' Is Stinky
51.overview: n the wake of a rocky tribal council, a castaway makes a shocking move. A mysterious Tree Mail delivers a game-changing twist. Then, two castaways secretly bond at tribal council in an attempt to change the course of the vote.

51.name: That's the Magic of Survivor
51.overview: In a Tale of Two Tribes, one tribe feels torn apart in the aftermath of a divisive vote-out, while another tribe basks in unity, until an unexpected summoning changes everything. Then, old wounds and previous alliances are put to the test at tribal council.

51.name: Not Here to Get a Pedicure
51.overview: This week's Immunity Challenge comes with double jeopardy when two tribes face tribal council.

51.name: I Love Crying
51.overview: A bold move to save a castaway at the last tribal council causes fractures to the Dina Tribe. A mysterious meeting will tie the fates of some players together. Then, emotions run hot in a high-stakes challenge that tests the tribes.

51.name: The Girl at the Prom
51.overview: The castaways face a daunting rite of passage that harkens all the way back to Season 1; chaos ensues as the group mingles and navigates old alliances and new promises while battling for the first individual immunity necklace of the season.

51.name: Load the Ark, Two by Two

overview: در این مسابقه گروهی از افراد در یک محل منزوی مانند جزیره قرار داده می‌شوند. این افراد در دو گروه مختلف قرار می‌گیرند و هیچ امکان رفاهی در اختیارشان نیست و هر گروه باید خودشان سعی کنند از محیط غذایشان را تهیه کنند برای خودشان جایی برای اقامت تدارک ببینند.

seasons.name: San Juan del Sur - Blood vs. Water
Game Changers - Mamanuca Islands
seasons.overview: The 34th season is themed “Game Changers” and takes place in the Mamanuca Islands in Fiji. It features 20 returning castaways who helped evolve the game even further by launching an accelerated level of competition and proven willingness to risk it all.

seasons.name: Heroes v. Healers v. Hustlers
seasons.overview: In the 35th season, the show returns to the Mamanuca Islands in Fiji and features 18 castaways divided into three groups of six based on how they are perceived by others. Heroes are used to being heralded, healers receive gratitude for their work, and hustlers must earn respect.

seasons.name: Island of the Idols
seasons.overview: In this 20-year-strong series, 20 castaways embark on a dramatic 39-day quest to claim the $1 million prize and be named Sole Survivor. But this season the game gets a bold new layer when two of the greatest players in Survivor history, Boston Rob Mariano and Sandra Diaz‑Twine arrive not as competitors, but as mentors on the mysterious "Island of the Idols".

seasons.name: Winners at War
seasons.overview: The 20th-anniversary edition of the groundbreaking series unites the most memorable, heroic and celebrated champions from the past two decades in the biggest battle in the show's history, as the series' best strategists of all time fight to earn the title of Sole Survivor again.

seasons.name: Season 41
seasons.overview: As TV's preeminent reality series for 20 years, Survivor 41 begins a bold new era with the introduction of exciting fresh elements to the competition, which promise to intensify the battle for $1 million and the title of Sole Survivor.

seasons.name: Season 42
seasons.overview: After 20 years, the groundbreaking reality television show continues to evolve when these 18 new players face one of the most intense versions of Survivor ever. Values will be tested and the players' motivations highlighted when the fierce competition unfolds on the beautiful islands of Fiji.

seasons.name: Season 43
seasons.overview: Survivor continues to evolve when these 18 new players are stranded on the beautiful islands of Fiji and must form a society and adapt to their physical and social surroundings, forcing players to choose between personal risk and reward, while navigating the complex social game and attempting to forge alliances to last another day.

seasons.name: Season 44
seasons.overview: Stranded in the beautiful islands of Fiji, these 18 determined new castaways will be divided into three tribes of six and forced to form a new society as they adapt to their physical and social surroundings. The mental and physical challenges force players to choose between personal risk and reward, while still navigating the complex social game and attempting to forge alliances to last another day. The individuals competing are from diverse backgrounds with the same ultimate goal: to outwit, outplay and outlast and ultimately be crowned Sole Survivor.

seasons.name: Season 45
seasons.overview: Eighteen castaways are stranded on the exotic islands of Fiji and divided into three tribes of six. From the moment they step on the beach, they must form a new society, adapt to their physical and social surroundings, face treacherous new elements and grueling mental and physical challenges, and navigate an ever-shifting social game, all with one goal: to outwit, outplay and outlast the others, claim the title of Sole Survivor and win the $1 million prize.

seasons.name: Season 46
seasons.overview: Eighteen castaways from across the country will be stranded on the beaches of Fiji and forced to form a new society as they adapt to their physical and social surroundings. They will compete in grueling mental and physical challenges, navigate moral dilemmas and extreme situations, and employ ever-evolving strategies in order to outwit, outplay and outlast their competition, with only one earning the title of Sole Survivor and the $1 million prize.

seasons.name: Season 47
seasons.overview: A new crop of 18 castaways will embark on the adventure of a lifetime in hopes of winning the title of Sole Survivor and the $1 million grand prize. Stranded on the beautiful, but brutal, islands of Fiji, they must form a new society, adapt to their surroundings, compete in physical and mental challenges, navigate ever-shifting alliances and make big decisions under pressure. In this season, nothing is certain, and every move could be your last.

seasons.name: Season 48
seasons.overview: Nearly 25 years since it first premiered, Survivor returns for its 48th season as the ultimate test of physical and mental will, and the adventure of a lifetime, for a fresh group of 18 castaways stranded on the beaches of Fiji. Armed with new perspectives and fierce passion for the game, they will compete for the title of Sole Survivor and the $1 million prize.

seasons.name: Season 49
seasons.overview: Twenty-five years after it first premiered, Survivor continues to prove both the ultimate test of physical and mental will, as well as the adventure of a lifetime, for castaways stranded on the beaches of Fiji and tasked with forming a new society, adapting to their surroundings and navigating an unpredictable social game to ensure their torch stays lit. The players competing on the 49th season are diverse competitors armed with fresh perspectives and a fervent passion for the game, with the same ultimate goal: to claim the title of Sole Survivor and win the $1 million prize.

seasons.name: Season 50
seasons.overview: Survivor 50 will push the series into uncharted territory as 24 legendary castaways selected from 49 unforgettable seasons return to face surprise twists, high-stakes challenges, and fan-driven decisions. Survivor 50 is a celebration of legacy, strategy, and audience impact in the evolution of this groundbreaking game. This milestone season promises unparalleled gameplay as contestants battle for the title of Sole Survivor and the $1 million prize.

seasons.name: Season 51
seasons.overview: 21 new Castaways are set to embark on the adventure of a lifetime. Stranded on the beaches of Fiji they’re tasked with forming a new society, adapting to their surroundings, and navigating an unpredictable social game to ensure their torch stays lit. The Open Era will test their endurance, strategy, and willpower in pursuit of the title of Sole Survivor and the $1 million grand prize.
